summary: Only a tnlandforms list entry names a tower at Lick Mountain. TopoQuest calls the point a summit, and no source describes a Lick Mountain tower.

notes_for_editor: No story written. The only tower evidence is one tnlandforms list entry; its fifth column (gw) is unexplained. TopoQuest places Lick Mountain Summit close to that list point and lists it as a summit, not a tower. The NHLR North Carolina list has 31 registered lookouts and includes Buck Mountain Fire Tower (US 1407, NC 27) in Montgomery County, but not Lick Mountain. The NHLR covers registered lookouts, so its absence does not settle whether a tower stood here (inference). The brief's kind 'tower' is unverified. A human should decide whether this record stays visible. No corrections proposed because no source proves an error in the brief.
